content: Kâlawk tarawi hane hoi bawk hanelah counnae

content.text: Oe, tho awh haw, BAWIPA koe la sak awh sei.
Maimae rungngangnae lungsong hah
pholen laihoi lunghawi hoi hram awh sei .
Lunghawilawkdeinae lahoi a hmalah cet awh sei.
Lunghawinae la hoi ama koe hram awh sei.
BAWIPA teh ka lentoe e Cathut lah ao,
cathut pueng e Siangpahrang kalen lah ao.
Talai a dungpoungnae teh a kut dawk ao teh,
mon karasangnaw hai amae doeh.
Talîpui hai a sak teh, amae doeh.
Talai hai a kutsak doeh.
Tho awh, tabo laihoi bawk awh sei.
BAWIPA na kasakkung hmalah
khokcuengkhuem awh sei.
Ama teh maimae Cathut doeh.
Maimouh hai ama koe ka pawngpa e
a kut rahim e tuhu lah o awh.
Sahnin vah nangmouh teh
a lawk na thai awh nahlangva
na lungpatak sak hanh awh.
Nangmae mintoenaw ni kum 40 touh thung,
kai hah aphunphun lah na tanouk awh teh,
kaie thaw a hmunae kahrawngum vah,
kai na taran awh teh,
na tanouk awh e patetlah awm awh hanh leih.
Hote miphunnaw hah kai ni ka panuet teh,
a lungthin lam pou ka payon e lah ao awh.
Kaie lamthung hah panuek thai awh hoeh.
Hatdawkvah, ka lungkhuek teh,
kaie kâhatnae hmuen koe na kâen awh mahoeh, telah thoe ka bo.
